_about: Key-to-icon mapping for the LOCAL icon build of the MSFS 2024 default Boeing 737 MAX 8 profile (docs/icons.md; personal use only, never committed: the icon profile and the images are written to the git-ignored .local/ folder). Names and sha256 only, in the form of icons-cj4.json. The trim, views and simrate rows are the CJ4 mapping's rows as they are; the other rows follow one rule per key kind, with the A32NX mapping's airliner faces (FCU pushbuttons, knobs, blank pushbutton and readout faces, the numbered folders). Only pack files that the committed mappings already name. Not yet look-tested.
